subject: Orbit Systems x Redwood — marketplace co-sell demo & preflight
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@orbit-si.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Market Demo: Orbit Systems + Redwood — scheduling & preflight

Hi Vivek / Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking this partnership forward — Orbit is excited to run a joint marketplace demo targeting a shortlist of mid-market ISVs next week. We want the session to highlight: marketplace listing flow, Dedicated deployment benefits, and an SI handoff runbook.

Available windows on our side (PDT):
- Mon 9/6 9:30–10:30 or 11:00–12:00
- Tue 9/7 10:00–11:00

We’d like a 45–60 minute demo + 15 minute Q&A. Can you confirm Redwood availability and whether you can include an AWS marketplace contact for listing/recording guidance?

I’ve attached a very brief runbook (runbook_v1.pdf) and a proposed attendee list. Also looping Tim Jones from CloudForge (our procurement lead) — Tim, FYI.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, Orbit Systems
Attachments: runbook_v1.pdf (stub), attendee_list.csv (stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@orbit-si.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Market Demo: Orbit Systems + Redwood — scheduling & preflight

Hi Marta — great to hear and thanks for the runbook.

Quick notes:
- The 9/6 11:00–12:00 PDT slot works best for our field team; we can do 45 minutes demo + 15 Q&A.
- We want to run a 30-minute dry run two business days prior (Thu 9/2) to walk through the marketplace flow, recording handoff, and SI handover slides. Can your technical lead join?
- I’m looping Karthik to coordinate the SI/ops runbook and Vanessa for marketplace listing touches.

Kimberly, can you confirm whether an AWS marketplace contact should be on the main demo or only on the dry run? If we need marketplace listing guidance live, I can invite aws-marketplace@amazon.com.

Attachments: I’m attaching an internal dry-run checklist (redwood_dryrun_checklist.xlsx) and a proposed calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics).

Next steps:
1) Marta to confirm 9/6 11:00–12:00 PDT for live demo
2) Tim/Orbit to nominate technical lead for 9/2 dry run
3) Kimberly to confirm AWS contact inclusion

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0128

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@orbit-si.com>

Sounds good — 9/6 11:00–12:00 PDT is confirmed on our calendar.

Tim (cc’d) will nominate our technical lead for the dry run; Tim — can you share availability for Thu 9/2 morning (PDT)?

We’d prefer AWS marketplace contact on the live demo so they can confirm listing/recording constraints in real time. Please invite aws-marketplace@amazon.com.

Quick note: the runbook you attached looked good; we updated one minor item (step 4b) — uploaded the edit to the Drive link Marta included earlier.

Team,

Recap and owners after Marta’s confirmation:
- Live demo: Mon 9/6 11:00–12:00 PDT — record, focus on marketplace listing flow and SI handoff (Owner: Vivek)
- Dry run: Thu 9/2 09:30–10:00 PDT — technical walk (Owner: Karthik)
- Marketplace contact: aws-marketplace@amazon.com invited for live demo (Owner: Kimberly to confirm contact name)
- Recording ownership: Redwood will own the recording and push to the marketplace listing folder (Owner: Vanessa)
- Runbook edits: Orbit uploaded a minor change; Karthik to validate step 4b against our Dedicated deployment notes

Please confirm by EOD: 1) Kimberly — name of AWS contact, 2) Tim — technical lead & availability for 9/2 morning.
